**10. Portfolio Recommendation?**
Favor selective semiconductors and Healthcare exposure while reducing exposure to stretched megacap names showing CORRECTION/RECOVERY patterns. Given NEUTRAL regime and narrow leadership, remain selective and monitor trend confirmation before increasing cyclical risk.
